patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I switched to a new dish soap and now both my hands are red, dry, and so itchy. It's just where the soap touched — no fever, I feel totally fine otherwise.
presentation.triageNote: 40-year-old female with an itchy, red, dry, scaling rash on both hands after changing dish soap. The rash follows the contact areas; she is afebrile and has no facial swelling, breathing symptoms, or systemic illness.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this localized contact-pattern dermatitis requires no counted emergency resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has a symmetric itchy hand rash following a new soap exposure, without systemic allergic features.
clinical.acuityReason: The exposure pattern, scaling, and absence of fever, facial swelling, or respiratory symptoms support localized skin inflammation.
keyFindings: Itchy red dry scaling rash on both hands
No facial swelling or breathing symptoms
teachingPoints: Avoiding the trigger is central to recovery.
Rapidly spreading hives, facial or tongue swelling, wheeze, vomiting, or hypotension would indicate a systemic reaction.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Trigger avoidance, skin protection, emollient use, and topical medication would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, holding out both reddened hands
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: an asian 40-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: holding out both reddened, irritated hands. Expression: mildly bothered but well. Clearly visible: red, irritated skin on both hands. No text, no logos.
